Lazy Circles Wednesday Night Ride

Norman, OK · Downtown Norman · Road · Social

Beginner friendly

Lazy Circles Wednesday Night Ride is a road and social group ride in Norman, OK. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:30 pm from Lazy Circles Brewing. Pace: three groups: 11, 14 and 16 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Lazy Circles Wednesday Night Ride group ride

Norman's entry-level weeknight ride. Three groups leave the brewery at 11, 14 and 16 mph and are back in about an hour. Supported by the Bicycle League of Norman, Phat Tire, Scissortail Cycles and Buchanan Bicycles. Does not run in rain.
